[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort
 Section: 72::One year.
]


For compensation for doing or for omitting to do an act alleged to be in pursuance of any enactment in force for the time being in the territories to which this Act extends.
Period of limitationOne year.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the act or omission takes place.
